svg.title: The two pramāṇas of the Tattvārthasūtra
svg.desc: A tree. At the root, the five kinds of knowledge as pramāṇas in the Tattvārthasūtra. One branch is parokṣa, indirect, with two kinds: mati, through the senses and mind, and śruta, scriptural knowledge. The other branch is pratyakṣa, direct, known by the soul itself, with three kinds: avadhi, clairvoyance; manaḥparyāya, knowing other minds; and kevala, omniscience.
svg.text: pratyakṣa: direct, known by the soul itself
mati: through the senses and mind
